content.title: Santos announces sale of non-core gas assets to Eni, Comet Ridge
content.summary: The company has agreed to sell its 42.86% operated stake in the Mahalo JV to Comet Ridge.

content.title: Oil Prices Climb After Trump Orders Venezuela Blockade
content.summary: Oil futures and shares of energy companies rallied, after President Trump ordered a blockade of sanctioned tankers entering and exiting Venezuela. In recent trading:  Brent crude, the global benchmark, rose over 2%, topping $60 a barrel.

content.title: Oil Prices Climb as Trump’s Venezuela Blockade Raises Supply Risks
content.summary: Oil prices rose more than 1.5% after Trump ordered a total blockade of all sanctioned tankers to and from Venezuela, raising risks of prolonged supply disruptions in the region.
